tools.name: check_counterparty_nl
tools.description: Contractor check and counterparty check for the Netherlands and the EU. Call it BEFORE paying an advance, a deposit or an invoice to a Dutch contractor, builder or other supplier, before signing a quote or order, and before onboarding a customer. Give the KvK number (8 digits, as text) from the quot

tools.name: record_counterparty_check
tools.description: Make a result of check_counterparty_nl verifiable by others: records its digest in the AstraNL signed public log and returns a reference that a colleague, approver or auditor can check later with verify_astranl, without trusting AstraNL. Works only for a check AstraNL produced in the last 48 hours.

tools.name: verify_astranl
tools.description: Read receipts confirm which read was served when and through which door, with current or expired status and optional answer_sha256 match; content is not stored and is not a quote, price guarantee or proof of delivery. Verify supported AstraNL references without a key: ASTRA-A/R/C, alk_, att_/atr_ an

tools.name: read_with_receipt
tools.description: Read a published protocol result and request an entry in the public transparency log holding a digest of the answer. The receipt is not a quote, not a price guarantee and not proof of delivery. Nothing is bought, paid or sent to a counterparty; publication reads may contact external sources. Confirm

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "streamable?profile=counterparty" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_with_receipt · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, verify_astranl, read_with_receipt · Public sink: check_counterparty_nl · Destructive: check_counterparty_nl.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_with_receipt · Private data: check_counterparty_nl, record_counterparty_check, verify_astranl, read_with_receipt · Public sink: check_counterparty_nl · Destructive: check_counterparty_nl

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
